answer: Each identity must hold one registry-verified pilot licence, a 250-hour logbook including night navigation by nebula charts, and a medical certificate. One licence backs one identity; a duplicate claim suspends both, and lapsed medical or currency suspends weight. One required leg is a night flight to an island airstrip over the inlet. Each fake costs one trainee, 250 hours, 12 months, 9,500 units; 100 fakes cost 950,000 units. A borrowed logbook fails: school, radar and medical records must match one person; a forged entry with no radar match revokes the identity and audits its school.
